# Pull Request History

PR-history learning is optional and occurs only during `wiki init` or
`wiki reinit`.

1. Detect GitHub/GitHub Enterprise or Azure DevOps from `origin`.
2. Check existing authenticated `gh`, or `az` plus the Azure DevOps extension.
3. Obtain consent in interactive `auto` mode. Non-interactive use skips unless
   the user explicitly selects `on`.
4. Collect at most 100 merged PRs from the rolling previous 120 days and at
   most 1,000 human review threads. Exclude bots, deleted comments, and open or
   unmerged PRs.
5. Run `kit wiki collect-pr-history` before producing synthesis. Keep normalized
   raw evidence only under `.git/agentic-kit/pr-history/`.
6. Give one bounded, temporary Repository Scout access to that cache during
   wiki initialization only. It returns candidate lessons plus PR/thread IDs,
   never raw bodies or reviewer identities. The orchestrator forwards only
   those candidates for current-source checking and independent review.
7. Write `.wiki/review-practices.md` only when a lesson appears in accepted
   feedback across two independent PRs, or in a request-changes review followed
   by a code change, and tracked current source supports it.

Target 3,000-4,000 tokens and never exceed 20,000 characters. Prefer frequent,
high-impact lessons; remove duplicate examples and low-confidence guidance
first. Store concise team expectations and PR/thread identifiers, never raw
comments, reviewer personalities, credentials, or obsolete preferences.

Use `--pr-history auto|on|off`. `auto` is consented interactive discovery,
`on` is explicit collection and fails when tooling/authentication is missing,
and `off` performs no remote inspection.
